title: Irving House

buildingCutout.basis: The native Irving House footprint includes its attached verandah, roof and downhill wing.

terrainReference.basis: Unchanged Copernicus GLO-30 DSM sampled from the Royal Avenue front gate toward the downhill basement.

identities.name: Irving House
identities.address: 302 Royal Avenue, New Westminster, British Columbia, Canada

mapIdentity.scope: OSM way 391276941 controls the existing building and verandah footprint at the recorded street address. The Canadian Register identifies the street facade, later wraparound extension and slope.

note: The original ca. 1880 municipal archive photograph sets the shapes of the steep front gable, balcony, porch trim and chimneys. The official register describes the exposed rear basement and main roof.
